data.name: VIREN
data.detailed_description:
Awakened in the ruins of a post-apocalyptic future, you find yourself trapped inside a surreal, lonely world that feels more like a simulation than reality. Guided only by fragments of memory, you begin to uncover the truth behind your existence—and the purpose that binds you to this place.

VIREN is a cinematic third-person action-adventure that combines atmospheric exploration with intense combat. Armed with an arsenal of weapons and evolving abilities, you’ll face towering mechanical Guardians that guard the secrets of this decaying world. Each encounter tests your reflexes, precision, and understanding of your environment.

Explore desolate structures swallowed by time, confront the remnants of a civilization that collapsed under its own creation, and descend deeper into a system that was never meant to be broken. Every battle, every echo, draws you closer to the truth of who you are—and why you were brought here.

Features:

  • Cinematic third-person gameplay blending exploration and combat

  • A hauntingly beautiful post-apocalyptic sci-fi world

  • Challenging boss fights against mysterious mechanical Guardians

  • Arsenal of weapons and abilities offering tactical freedom

  • Story-rich progression through a linear yet immersive world

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
